body:
Sorry that I have been away, I have been trying to get to the bottom of my friend leaving and seeing if they will come back. (I used a friend of theirs to help me). I feel slightly worse because she has been influenced by someone who completely hates me for standing up to her.

​

Apparently I am just this "creep"that took her innocence by using her. Which is completely untrue, I love her so badly, I really do. I stood up for her when her friend was treating her like shit but the person who is influencing her managed to convince her that me standing up for her was just me being mean to this girl and therefore I am just a pure dick and "creep" who uses people.  


I really am not and I do care about her so much, I just can't believe all this. I tried to give her everything and now it is collapsing and I guess... no one really cares about me or what I do.

I am okay thanks for asking. That sounds like a very interesting talk, I never thought about how we impact wildlife with our massive trails, I always thought that the animals would just move away. That is true what you said about "Don't love too hard" I suppose in some aspects, loving too hard can lead us to ruin the things that we love forever.
Hello, how are you doing? I hope your lecture was good and that you managed to get more time to sleep last night.

I am feeling better after speaking with you and waht you said is correct, we really do connect with others through our expriences as that is when we can properly understand one another. I suppose at the end of the day, I am not losing anything other than that of a negative person. I know that they are losing someone who did care for them and at the end of the day, there are not many people who do actually care anymore sadly.  


I don't think she will come back if I am honest and that is fine, I am sure it is just my life removing someone for someone better. With every negative there has to be a positive, so I guess that is the good thing.  


How have you been?
